prompt:
Response cost is wrong when usage.iterations report their own model

When a response carries `usage.iterations`, `messageCostUsd` (src/api/pricing.ts) bills each iteration at the requested model unless the iteration's type is `fallback_message`. Other iteration types can also say which model actually served them, and that model is ignored.

Repro: requested model claude-opus-5-5, one iteration `{ type: "advisor_message", model: "claude-haiku-5-5", input_tokens: 1_000_000, output_tokens: 1_000_000 }`. The cost comes out at Opus rates ($24). It should be $0.60 at Haiku rates. A `{ type: "message", model: "claude-sonnet-5-5", input_tokens: 1_000_000 }` iteration has the same problem.

There is a second problem going the other way. A `fallback_message` iteration whose `model` is null makes the whole response unpriced (undefined), so the cost display goes blank.

Expected: an iteration that names a model is priced at that model, whatever its type. An iteration with no model (missing or null) is priced at the requested model. If any iteration is on a model with no known price, the whole response stays unpriced, as it is now.

Add or update tests as appropriate.
